text: Dalia's daughter has her first violin recital Saturday at 2pm. She's more nervous than the kid is tbh
Call with Michael. His brother Sam is running the Manchester half on Sunday morning, first one ever, and he's been training since March. Remind me to text Sam good luck the night before
ok so um Victor said his mum's in hospital again, they think it's her heart, she goes in for tests on Thursday morning and he's driving her
Lwazi - 5 a side final next Weds 7pm. wants us all there. bring the speaker
Divya and her husband are off to Lisbon on the 12th for their anniversary. Back the following Monday. Ask her how it was afterwards
Naledi's play opens at the Arcola on Friday! She plays the sister. Opening night at half 7, I've got two tickets for me and Tobi
need to pick up dry cleaning before 6 and drop the parcel at the post office
emeka mentioned his son Chidi got into the county under 14s squad. trials were brutal apparently. he's buzzing

Coffee with Caitlin. She's been really struggling since the breakup with Liam, not sleeping much and she's lost weight. Her sister Niamh is coming to stay for a bit next week which should help, and her mum keeps ringing every night which she finds a lot. Work have been decent about it. I should check in with her Sunday evening and maybe suggest the cinema
Karan's band have a gig at the Brudenell on the 3rd at 9. He's on bass. Said Divya might come too
Darius told me the wedding's off. Him and Jess split up over the summer, he only told people last week. Don't make a thing of it but maybe take him for a pint at some point
lola's dog Biscuit had his op this morning, all went fine, she picks him up tomorrow at 10
Fatima's kids both have their swimming gala on Saturday, starts at 9am, and then her eldest has a piano exam the Monday after. Busy week for her. Remind me to ask how the exam went that evening
Aurelio is obsessed with padel at the moment, plays three times a week

voice note. Abdi rang. his dad passed away on Tuesday night, it was quite sudden, a stroke. funeral is Friday the 18th at 11 at the mosque on Green Lane and then back to the family house afterwards. he sounded exhausted, he's been sorting everything because his older brother is stuck in Nairobi. I need to send flowers to his mum before then and call him the day after the funeral
Mia's choir concert got called off, the venue flooded. They're rescheduling for spring
carmen + juan hosting a bbq sunday afternoon for juan's 40th. I'm doing the salads
Fiona has her driving test Thursday at 8:40am, third attempt, she's really anxious about it. Text her good luck that morning, and don't forget to ask how it went after
Henrik is vegan now, and allergic to sesame. Keep in mind for the dinner
Tomás (Tommy) is doing the Ironman in Tenby in September. He's mad. Training every morning at 5

Saw Pedro at the school gates. His wife Ana is due any day now, they've had two false alarms already, and their eldest Sofia starts reception in September so they're also doing school visits. He's running on fumes. He mentioned his parents are coming over from Porto the week after the baby arrives to help out, which he seemed a bit mixed about
Joseph's mum turns 80 on the 22nd. Big lunch at the Ivy on the Saturday. He wants ideas for presents, she loves gardening and those posh candles
Luis said his nephew is in the regional chess championship this weekend and he's driving him up to Leeds Saturday morning
remind me to ask Mariam how her son's grade 5 trumpet went
Aiko - moved into the new flat in Hackney last week. Still boxes everywhere. Cat Miso hates it, hides under the bed
Mehmet's daughter Elif is in the school production of Matilda, she's Miss Trunchbull lol. Shows are Wed and Thurs at 6:30. He asked if I'd come to the Thursday one
kasia's partner Ola has a big presentation to the board tomorrow morning at 9, she was helping him rehearse all weekend. he's not slept

Long chat with Niamh on the phone. Her mum had a fall last month and has broken her wrist, so Niamh's been going over every evening after work. Her brother Declan is meant to be helping but he's in Dublin and never answers. She's knackered and a bit fed up with him, understandably. On top of that her own half marathon is on the 9th and she's barely trained. Need to call her the weekend before and maybe offer to do a shop for her mum
Booked the dentist for Tues 4th at 3:15. Car MOT the week after
Dalia mentioned her son Omar and his girlfriend are expecting! Due in January. Dalia's going to be a granny, she can't stop smiling
michael was telling me his partner Rob got the promotion to head of sales. starts the new role after christmas. they're celebrating on friday night
Victor's band won the battle of the bands last night!! Through to the final in Bristol on the 30th
Note: Lwazi doesn't drink, prefers lime and soda. Also hates being called Lwaz

Divya's brother Arjun is getting married in Jaipur in Feb. She's flying out on the 2nd and staying two weeks, the mehndi is on the 6th and the wedding itself the day after. Her mum's stressing about the seating plan already and Arjun apparently couldn't care less. Divya's doing a dance with her cousins and is terrified. Ask her for pics when she's back
Tobi said the boxing match is postponed again, now the 14th. He's gutted but it gives him more time to cut weight

um so Emeka and his wife Ngozi are doing the Great North Run together on the 8th for her dad's charity, the one for Parkinson's. remind me to sponsor them before and then send them a message the next day to see how they did
Sam Hughes from work - wife's having surgery on her knee on Monday. He's taking the week off. I should cover his Weds meeting
Caitlin's grandad is 95 on Sunday. The whole family is going to his care home for cake at 3
Karan has his first stand up gig at an open mic on Thursday at 8. Petrified. Do NOT forget to text him that afternoon. Divya and I might go and sit at the back
Darius' little girl Maya had her first ballet show yesterday, he sent a video, she just waved at him the whole time haha
lola and her girlfriend Mia are moving to Bristol at the end of next month. lola's starting at the uni in Jan. sad but happy for them
Fatima said her husband's redundancy meeting is Friday at 11. They're both worried. Ask her on Saturday how it went
just a reminder to self - water the plants, cancel the gym trial before Friday

Aurelio's son Matteo plays for the under 12s, they've got the cup final on Saturday at 10 at Hackney Marshes. Aurelio is more nervous than Matteo, honestly. His wife Giulia is working so can't make it, and the car's in the garage, so he asked if I could give them a lift there, said yes. Need to leave by 9. Matteo wants to be a keeper like his dad was
Abdi is into vinyl, mostly 70s soul and jazz. He was saying he's after an original pressing of What's Going On. Good shout for his birthday in May
Mia had her cello audition for the Royal Northern on Tuesday. Hears back in about three weeks. She thinks it went ok
Carmen's mum is staying with them for a month from the 1st. Carmen sounded a bit frazzled about it
Text from Juan, the five a side tonight is off, half the team have flu
Fiona passed!!! Finally. Taking her for a celebratory drink Saturday
Henrik Andersson - new neighbour at no. 14. Swedish, works at the hospital as a radiographer. Two kids, Freja and Oskar, and a massive dog called Bamse

tomas said his sister Lucia is singing at the jazz festival on the 17th, 4pm slot on the main stage, biggest gig she's ever done. his parents are flying over from Madrid for it and staying the week after, so he's repainting the spare room this weekend in a panic. she's been doing vocal lessons twice a week. remind me to ask tommy for the stream link
Pedro's wife had the baby! Little boy, Rafael, born Tuesday morning. Both doing well. I must send a card and maybe a hamper the week after when they've settled
Joseph is playing in the club tennis tournament this weekend, semis Saturday afternoon and final Sunday if he gets through. Hasn't lost a set all season
Called Luis back. His mum's results came back clear, huge relief. He's taking her away to Cornwall for a few days at the end of the month

Mariam and Aiko were both at Kasia's thing last night. Mariam's starting a new job at the BBC on Monday, producer on the radio side, which she's been after for ages. Aiko's off to Japan for three weeks on the 20th to see her gran, who isn't well. Kasia was quiet all night and left early, I think something's up with her. Should message her later in the week
Mehmet said his brother's restaurant opens on Saturday. Launch party Friday night 7pm, invite only, he got me on the list
Kasia texted - she and Ola broke up. She's ok-ish. I'll pop round with wine tomorrow evening
Note from the hairdresser chat: Naledi's mum is a retired music teacher, still plays organ at their church every Sunday morning

So the race was today, Michael finished in 3 hours 52, his first marathon. His kids were waiting at mile 20 with signs and his wife ran the last bit with him. He did it for the hospice that looked after his dad, raised nearly two grand. He's already talking about Berlin next year. I need to message him tomorrow to say well done and ask if he can walk yet

Emeka's twins have their nativity on the 15th at 2pm. One's a shepherd and the other is, I quote, a sad donkey. He's working so his mum is going instead and she's promised to film it, though she always films her own thumb. He's gutted to miss it. Remind me to ask him for photos the day after
